description: Full-stack task board: Next.js frontend, NestJS API, PostgreSQL, Docker, with registration, login, and per-user task management.

tasks.title: Scaffold the NestJS API service and wire Postgres into the stack
tasks.description: Scaffold the NestJS api repo (TypeScript) with Prisma and PostgreSQL, add a health endpoint and a multi-stage Dockerfile, and bring up postgres + api via the workspace docker-compose.
acceptanceCriteria: The api repo builds and boots; GET /api/v1/health returns 200 with a status payload.
Prisma is configured against PostgreSQL and connects on startup.
The api Dockerfile builds a multi-stage, non-root image.
docker compose up brings up postgres and api, with api waiting for db health before starting.
The project's lint, type-check, and build commands pass.

tasks.title: Add the user account data model
tasks.description: Add the Prisma User model (unique email, name, passwordHash, timestamps) and the migration required by authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: The User model stores a unique email and a password hash.
The migration applies and rolls back successfully.
A duplicate email is rejected at the database level.
Relevant model and migration tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement registration and login authentication
tasks.description: Implement register, login, refresh, logout, and me endpoints using JWT access tokens, a refresh cookie, and bcrypt password hashing.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid registration creates a user with a bcrypt password hash and never returns the hash.
Valid credentials return an access token and set a refresh cookie.
Invalid credentials return 401 without revealing which field was wrong.
POST /auth/refresh issues a new access token from a valid refresh cookie.
GET /auth/me returns the authenticated user's profile.
Authentication e2e tests pass.

tasks.title: Add the JWT auth guard and current-user decorator
tasks.description: Add a reusable JWT guard and a @CurrentUser() decorator so protected routes resolve the authenticated user.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests without a valid bearer token to a protected route are rejected with 401.
The @CurrentUser() decorator resolves the authenticated user id.
Guard behaviour is covered by tests.

tasks.title: Create the task data model
tasks.description: Add the Prisma Task model (title, optional description, due date, completed, owner relation, timestamps, indexes) and its migration.
acceptanceCriteria: A Task stores a title, optional description, optional due date, completion state, owner, and timestamps.
Deleting a user cascades to their tasks.
Indexes support listing tasks by owner and completion state.
The migration and model tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement per-user task CRUD endpoints
tasks.description: Implement create, paginated list, get, update, and delete endpoints for tasks, scoped to the authenticated user's own tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: An authenticated user can create, list, read, update, and delete their own tasks.
A user cannot read, update, or delete another user's task (returns 404).
The list endpoint supports pagination and filtering by completion state.
Invalid input returns a structured 400 validation error.
Task CRUD e2e tests pass.

tasks.title: Standardize API responses, errors, and documentation
tasks.description: Add the global response interceptor, global exception filter, startup env validation, and OpenAPI/Swagger docs, and document the API in the repo README.
acceptanceCriteria: Success responses share one envelope and errors share one structure.
Startup fails fast with a clear message when a required env var is missing.
Swagger UI is served and describes all endpoints.
The API README documents how to run, configure, and test the service.

tasks.title: Scaffold the Next.js web service with Docker
tasks.description: Create the Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) web repo with a standalone-output multi-stage Dockerfile, and add the web service to the root docker-compose.
acceptanceCriteria: The web app builds and runs; the home route renders.
The Dockerfile builds a minimal standalone image and serves the app as a non-root user.
docker compose up serves the web service alongside api and postgres.
The project's lint, type-check, and build commands pass.

tasks.title: Add the API client and authentication token handling
tasks.description: Add a typed API client that injects the bearer token, refreshes once on 401 via /auth/refresh, and clears auth on refresh failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests to the API include the access token when present.
A 401 triggers exactly one refresh attempt, then retries the original request.
A failed refresh clears auth state and redirects to /login.
The client is covered by tests.

tasks.title: Add registration, login, and protected routing
tasks.description: Add register and login pages, an auth provider that restores the session via /auth/me, and middleware that redirects unauthenticated users away from the task board.
acceptanceCriteria: The register and login forms submit and display validation errors accessibly.
Login failures are shown without clearing the email field.
Authenticated users land on the task board; unauthenticated users are redirected to login.
The flow is verified in the browser and relevant checks pass.

tasks.title: Build the task board list view
tasks.description: Render the authenticated user's tasks with loading, empty, and error states, using the API client and TanStack Query.
acceptanceCriteria: The board lists the current user's tasks from the API.
Loading, empty, and error states are each rendered appropriately.
The list is responsive and keyboard accessible.
The view is verified in the browser and relevant checks pass.

tasks.title: Add task creation
tasks.description: Add a create-task form that validates a nonempty title and adds the new task to the board.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can create a task with a nonempty title and optional details.
The form rejects an empty title before submitting.
The new task appears on the board without a full reload.
The flow is verified in the browser and relevant checks pass.

tasks.title: Add task completion, editing, and deletion
tasks.description: Allow a user to toggle completion, edit a task's details, and delete a task, with the board staying consistent after reload.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can mark an owned task complete and incomplete, and the state survives a reload.
A user can edit a task's title and details.
A user can delete a task after confirmation, and it disappears from the board.
The interactions are verified in the browser and relevant checks pass.

tasks.title: Wire the full stack, document it, and smoke test end to end
tasks.description: Finalize docker-compose (postgres + api + web), write the root README with run and smoke-test instructions, and verify the complete register-to-task-board flow in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose up starts postgres, api, and web, and migrations run automatically.
A first-time user can register, log in, and manage tasks entirely through the browser against the compose stack.
The root README documents setup, environment, and how to smoke test the stack.
The full end-to-end flow is verified and all project checks pass.
